discover.title: Discover
discover.emptyBody: Search for a song to get started. What you play will show up here.

search.title: Search
search.emptyBody: Type a song, artist, or album name to start searching.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.emptyBody: Tap the download button in the player to save a song. Downloaded songs play without a connection.
downloads.removeMessage: Remove "{0}" from this device? You can still stream it online.
downloads.failed: Could not download "{0}". Check your connection and retry.
downloads.listFailed: Could not read the downloads list.
downloads.sizeWarning: This one is about {0} because only a stream that includes video is available. Download it?

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.emptyBody: Tap the heart on an album or artist to save it. It will show up here.

history.title: History
history.clearMessage: Your entire listening history will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
history.emptyBody: Songs you play are saved here, even offline.

player.emptyBody: Pick a song from a list to start.
player.hint: Keeps playing when you leave the app · Changing tracks needs TubeMix open

detail.saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.

playlist.emptyBody: This playlist has no playable songs.

artist.openFailed: Could not open this artist page.
artist.emptyBody: This artist has no playable videos yet.

collection.emptyBody: This playlist is empty. Add songs from the search screen.

errors.offline: No internet connection. Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again.
errors.serverError: Could not load data from the server. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.noStream: No playable stream found for this video
errors.stalled: Could not load the data. Check your connection or try another song.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutBody: TubeMix Mobile is the mobile version of TubeMix for desktop. It streams music and keeps the audio going when you leave the app or lock the screen.
